tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You are part of your school's drama club and have been assigned the role of event coordinator for an upcoming play. You need to arrange for promotional materials, such as posters and flyers, to be printed and distributed. You want to contact a local print shop to discuss this.
Write an email to the print shop manager, Ms.Clark. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe the event and its importance.
Ask about their services for printing promotional materials.
Inquire about the costs and turnaround time for printing.
tasks.to: Ms. Clark Subject: Printing Services for Upcoming Play
tasks.subject: Printing Services for Upcoming Play
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms. Clark,



I hope this email finds you well. My name is Alfonso, an event coordinator from XDF school’s drama club. We are hosting our annual spring play, a key community event that showcases student talent and brings together students, parents, and local residents. To boost attendance, we need high-quality posters and flyers for campus and neighborhood distribution.



I am writing to inquire about your printing services for these promotional materials, including available paper stock, size options, and full-color printing capabilities. Could you also share the cost estimates for 50 posters and 200 flyers, as well as your typical turnaround time for this order?



Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your prompt reply.



Sincerely,

Alfonso
tasks.title: Write an Email
